parse_feedsim_metrics: parse FeedSim benchmark output to extract target latency, final QPS, and score metrics
use_feedsim_parser_class: use the FeedSimParser class to parse stdout from a FeedSim benchmark run into structured metrics
extract_target_latency: extract the target percentile and latency threshold from FeedSim benchmark output using regex
extract_final_qps: extract final requested QPS, achieved QPS, and latency from FeedSim benchmark output
calculate_feedsim_score: calculate the FeedSim benchmark score by dividing final achieved QPS by the baseline value
